s00922.summary: Marshal Hollis enters the salt chapel and finds Mercy and a hiding boy.
Hollis presses Mercy about the boy, the stolen payroll and the dead father.
Eli testifies his father shot first and fell into the well, not pushed.
Hollis weighs a trial; Eli volunteers to testify despite Mercy's objection.
Mercy yields the knife and offers her wrists; Hollis leads all three out.

s00408.summary: Dante scrapes a rooftop pipe while his brother Remy holds the sealant.
Remy bickers and bargains to be allowed a turn scraping.
Dante hands over the knife and Remy exposes a shining stripe of pipe.
Mrs. Alvarez climbs onto the roof; the brothers freeze, then she ignores them.
Dante drops the knife, they shove, spill sealant, and laugh.

s02210.summary: Five mourners linger in a side room after the funeral, silent.
Declan urges Maeve to sit; Aoife offers Brendan a stale biscuit.
Maeve asks the stranger Krane who he is and why he came.
Maeve insists Krane remove his coat and have tea; the family warms to him.
The organ stops and the funeral ends; they stay in the quiet.

s01892.summary: Vera, Petra and Bolt descend in a freight elevator with a stolen clock.
The elevator stalls; a guard's flashlight passes while they muffle the ticking clock.
Lights return and the doors open on the loading dock and van.

s02168.summary: A wary woman enters the pawn shop clutching a velvet pouch.
She sets down a gold locket; Joshua and the woman haggle over value.
Abraham and Joshua recognize the locket and Rosalie explains her mother pawned it.
Abraham insists the locket is a promise; Joshua relents and returns it.

s01296.summary: Mordecai enters the beekeeper's shed, grabs Ondine's wrist as the hives hum her name.
He says they want her back; she says they want what's in her.
He releases her, the humming stops, and a bee crawls from her veil.

s00254.summary: Five crew eat soup in tired silence in the habitat mess hall.
The crew trade flat small talk about the warming trench and pressure.
Mbali sees a large pale shape past the porthole; instruments show a thermal bloom.
Ilse studies the newcomer's remark, then orders everyone to eat before shift.
The newcomer gives his name Arthur and the crew welcome him, smiling.

s00023.summary: Wounded Saul, Nadia and courier Emeka are stuck in a cannery elevator.
Boots thump overhead then stop; Nadia silences Emeka.
Saul takes Emeka's backpack as the elevator starts rising.

s00060.summary: Two men trade barbs over chess on the night train while the conductor looks on.
Isadora holds up a brass key both men reach for, revealing an empty trunk.

s01749.summary: Augustus walks the casket showroom and a salesman appears at his elbow.
The salesman pitches a Starter casket while Augustus admits his wife is alive.
They realize the wife has waited forty minutes in a running car and sprint out.

s00540.summary: Four survivors drift in a life raft on a flat dawn sea.
Luciana insists on giving sleeping Pip more water, citing his mother's name.
Haakon and Mbeki recall a drumlike sound as fog parts on a giant iceberg.
Pip wakes asking about breakfast; Haakon fires the flare into the sky.

s00472.summary: Sunniva and Meriem enter the taxidermy hall to inventory the cases.
They find clean bare footprints crossing the dust and argue who made them.
They follow the prints to an open service door and a fresh wet footprint.
Sunniva notes basement off inventory; Meriem photographs it and the print vanishes.
They shut the door and walk out unhurried as glass eyes turn.

s01300.summary: A makeshift silo courtroom is set out with judge, counsel, bailiff and foreman.
The foreman hesitates over giving his verdict aloud; Nassar objects and is silenced.
The foreman finds for the farmers on count one, shocking Nassar.
Nassar demands a re-swearing and calls Hiram biased; Hiram says his land is poisoned.
Lomax calms Nassar, takes verdict on count two, and adjourns the court.

s01322.summary: Irina laces up at a garage roller derby track as Coach Boone watches over her.

s02238.summary: Four survivors sit silently in a lifeboat on a grey sea.
Ruth sets rations and Gustavo and Dwayne challenge her authority.
Ruth examines and has Gustavo dress his hand wound.
Dwayne doubts rescue is coming; Anneliese insists she dreamed it.
Ruth hands out crackers, and the four hum a song together.

s00621.summary: Elias sends telegrams as flood water seeps into the lock house office.
Marlow gates are gone; Elias orders everyone to move their things up.
Winifred stops Tobias and goes herself to shut the sluice wheel.
Elias keeps tapping steadily while the others wonder if she will return.

s02492.summary: Pottery students tease each other as Wilfred's vase struggles on the wheel.
The kiln buzzes; Mariska splatters Ephraim, and Wilfred asks to throw out his vase.

s02047.summary: Mourners wait wordlessly at the closed casket in the viewing room.
Maggie sits and takes Jojo's hand when Jojo joins her.
Beatrix stops knitting; the door swings open on its own and all four turn.

s01308.summary: Master binder Ashcroft faces his rigid new apprentice Adelaide in the bindery.
Ashcroft shows her uneven stitching; she admits she hurried from fear.
He orders her to unpick and resew the Bishop's Bible slowly.
Adelaide glimpses his grim kindness and thanks him; he tells her to thread.

s01555.summary: Two lawyers trade dry barbs in the corridor over his early-morning motion.
Donnelly announces the case moved to a feared new judge, Kowalczyk.
Harold says please and Donnelly grants a week's continuance.

s00840.summary: Three coworkers start a mattress-showroom escape room with an hour on the clock.
Grant tears open mattress boxes while Wanjiru and Francine watch.
Wanjiru finds a key under pillow six; Grant lunges for it.
Grant concedes control; Francine pockets the key and declares lunch.
They eat curry and laugh as Grant lets his exhaustion go.

s01414.summary: Sheriff Abner and deputy Percy wait while a woman sifts ash at a burnt wagon.
Esperanza crosses over and hands Abner a deed to the whole valley.
Silas rides in claiming Esperanza as property; she stands her ground.
Abner sends Percy home and Silas rides off with a warning.

s01856.summary: Langley questions Lady Whitmore about her whereabouts when the body was found.
A phone call reveals the gardener saw her carrying a spade at half past six.
Langley weighs the statue and tells her they must begin again.
